candidate.blueprint_locator: Psychosocial Integrity — therapeutic communication, cultural influences, and client-centered interactions
candidate.blueprint_topic: Psychosocial Integrity — culturally responsive active listening
candidate.educational_objective: Demonstrate culturally responsive active listening by verifying understanding and individualizing nonverbal communication.

options.A: Listen attentively, restate or paraphrase key points to verify understanding, and adapt eye contact to the client's preferences and cultural context
options.B: Maintain prolonged direct eye contact throughout the interaction because the same nonverbal behavior is appropriate in every culture
options.C: Interrupt frequently with advice so the client knows the nurse is engaged
options.D: Focus on preparing the next response while the client is speaking rather than verifying understanding

candidate.rationale: NCBI nursing guidance describes active listening as showing verbal and nonverbal interest while actively verifying understanding, for example by restating or paraphrasing what the client said. AHRQ TeamSTEPPS notes that expectations about eye contact can differ across cultural backgrounds. Therefore, the nurse should listen and verify understanding while adapting nonverbal behavior to the individual rather than imposing one universal eye-contact rule. A is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Active listening includes attentive verbal/nonverbal engagement and verification of understanding through restating/paraphrasing; eye-contact expectations can differ by cultural background.
candidate.source_document_title: Nursing: Mental Health and Community Concepts, Therapeutic Communication and the Nurse-Client Relationship; TeamSTEPPS 3.0 Communication
candidate.source_locator: NCBI Active Listening/Therapeutic Communication Techniques — restating/paraphrasing and verifying understanding; AHRQ Communication section — cultural differences in expectations regarding eye contact
candidate.source_organization: National Library of Medicine / NCBI Bookshelf (Open RN); Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ)

candidate.stem: A nurse is using active listening with a distressed client whose cultural background may make prolonged direct eye contact uncomfortable. Which behavior is most appropriate?
